institution: Max Planck Institute for Nuclear Physics (MPIK) and Heidelberg University

app_fee.value: Neither the IMPRS-QD application page nor the HGSFP portal/FAQ states an application fee (admitted doctoral students are exempt from university student/tuition fees, paying only a small semester administration fee upon registration).

also.quote: Do I have to pay fees when I register at the university? | No, doctoral students are exempt from student fees, but you do have to pay a small administration fee when registering.

fee_waiver.value: No application fee or fee waiver rule is stated on the IMPRS-QD or HGSFP pages.

gre_general.value: Neither the IMPRS-QD application page nor the HGSFP admission requirements mention the GRE.

toefl_min.value: Proof of proficiency in English is required if mother tongue is not English or German, but no TOEFL minimum score is stated.
toefl_min.quote: Proof of proficiency in English (if mother tongue is not English or German)

ielts_min.value: Proof of proficiency in English is required if mother tongue is not English or German, but no IELTS minimum score is stated.
ielts_min.quote: Proof of proficiency in English (if mother tongue is not English or German)

english_waiver.value: Proof of proficiency in English is required unless your mother tongue is English or German; the pages do not state whether an English-medium degree from India qualifies.
english_waiver.quote: Proof of proficiency in English (if mother tongue is not English or German)

notes: IMPRS-QD applications are submitted online via the Heidelberg Graduate School for Physics (HGSFP) portal. Checked IMPRS-QD application/offers pages, HGSFP admission requirements, FAQs, and 2024 doctoral studies brochure PDF; no application fee, GRE, TOEFL/IELTS cutoffs, or India MOI waiver rules are stated.
